title: Base Read Input Registers with exception-shaped response
purpose: Provide a complete Read Input Registers request followed by a structurally distinct protocol exception response, covering normal request parsing and cautious error-frame handling.

messages.label: Read Input Registers request, unit 4, start 48, quantity 6
Read Input Registers exception response, illegal-data-address form

expected_behavior: The server should parse the request as Read Input Registers for unit 4. The response is an exception-shaped frame carrying the matching transaction and unit identifiers; a conforming implementation may emit such a protocol-level exception when the requested range is unsupported or invalid.
constraints_preserved: Both frames use 7-byte MBAP headers and protocol identifier 0000.
The request MBAP length is 0006 for the unit identifier plus the 5-byte request PDU.
The exception response MBAP length is 0003 for the unit identifier plus the two-byte exception PDU.
The exception function byte is 84, corresponding structurally to function 04 with its high bit set, and the exception code is 02.
The response transaction identifier 0200 and unit identifier 04 match the request.
The request contains complete starting-address 0030 and quantity 0006 fields.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report is available. The exception-shaped response is included for cautious protocol-error coverage and does not assert a defect, exploitability, or security consequence.
